sources.text: and it was drawing toward tea time of a tuesday evening and there were fifteen boarders who were most of them punctual to a minute
but the cat crept behind the town walls to the church and devoured half the pot of fat
the great deliverer the friend of all those who need a mantle of darkness that they may escape from an anguish
and a shadow no longer skulked day and night at the entrance to the sanctuary
